newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea changes defence minister - state radio.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea changes defence minister - state radio.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam on Thursday replaced Defence Minister Lee Yang-ho with the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, Kim Dong-jin, state radio reported.

Lee's reported departure comes amid heavy public criticism of the military for failing to intercept a North Korean submarine that ran aground in South Korea last month, sparking a major security scare.
A presidential spokesman later confirmed the cabinet change, part of a sweeping reshuffle among the country's top military brass.
Kim will be succeeded by Yoon Young-nam, currently Chief of Staff of the South Korean army.

Yoon will be replaced by Do Il-kyu, presently commander of the Third Army responsible for the defence of the strategically crucial northwest area of South Korea, which borders North Korea and includes the capital Seoul.
The commanders of the First and Second armies also will be changed.
